title: Unity Assembly Definition
description: An assembly definition of Unity (.asmdef): the scripts of its folder compile into an assembly of their own.

name.description: The name of the assembly; the other assembly definitions refer to it by this name.

rootNamespace.description: The namespace of the new scripts of the folder (and of its subfolders, folder by folder).

references.description: The assembly definitions this one uses: by name, or "GUID:<guid of the .asmdef.meta>".

includePlatforms.description: The platforms the assembly is built for (empty: all of them but the excluded ones). "Editor" makes it an editor-only assembly.

excludePlatforms.description: The platforms the assembly is not built for (only when includePlatforms is empty).

allowUnsafeCode.description: Allows the unsafe keyword in the scripts of the assembly.

overrideReferences.description: Refer only to the precompiled assemblies of precompiledReferences, not to all of them.

precompiledReferences.description: The plug-in assemblies (.dll) this one refers to when overrideReferences is on.

autoReferenced.description: Assembly-CSharp and the other predefined assemblies refer to this one by themselves.

defineConstraints.description: Symbols that must all be defined (or, with !, undefined) for the assembly to be compiled.

versionDefines.description: Symbols defined when a package or module of a version range is in the project.

define.description: The symbol defined when the range matches.

noEngineReferences.description: No reference to the assemblies of UnityEngine (a plain .NET library).
